codes.description: Acute gastroenteropathy due to Norwalk agent

reason: Sequencing question: AKI documented as principal diagnosis due to dehydration from norovirus gastroenteritis; both AKI and gastroenteritis were POA and treated, so A08.11 could be sequenced as principal per guidelines/provider query. Progress notes on HD3 and HD4 contain conflicting copy-forward AKI 'worsening' statements inconsistent with Cr 0.9 and the discharge summary 'resolved', so a query may be needed. Losartan (ARB) contributing to AKI could suggest an adverse effect code (T50.5X5A?) but is not clearly documented as the cause. Unsteady gait and deconditioning documented separately; Z74.x/Z91.81 not assigned.
